text: ООО «БК «Олимп», the company behind the Olimpbet bookmaker brand, is held 97.5% by ООО «Зевс» and 2.5% by its founder Sergey Koziavkin (ЕГРЮЛ data); ООО «Зевс» is owned 50% by Darina Denisova and 50% by Andrey Petukhov.
short: Olimpbet (BK Olimp LLC) is privately owned, mostly via ООО «Зевс» (Darina Denisova 50%, Andrey Petukhov 50%).
